clauses.title: Scope – Requirements regarding materials,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements regarding materials, dimensions, manufacture and finish of sliding locking bolts commonly used for locking doors, gates, etc. with padlocks.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types Type I -  with straight lokcing plate, and Type II -  with curved locking plate.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 4. Material Part Material Bolt plate and Mild steel sheet receiving plate Aluminium alloy sheet Bolt Mild steel rods Aluminium alloy extruded rod For detailed information, refer to  IS  7534:1985 Specification for sliding locking bolts for use with pad locks (first revision).

clauses.title: Finish
